gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-nokora: Wallpoet lets paper show through in a thin line between letters. Nokora, a friendly sans-serif, lays down dark, sturdy lowercase and an s that stays open, so paragraphs read steadily line after line.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Loud, high-rising letters with white slicing through them. The strongest thing here is the gap: Wallpoet shouts in display style while Noto Kufi Arabic, a modern sans, speaks plainly.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-adlam-unjoi: Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined reads smoothly, with generous space around its curves. Beneath the bold, commanding Wallpoet, paragraphs of it would feel modern and unhurried, a quiet reply to a shout.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-anatolian-h: Wallpoet leaves thin lines of daylight between its letters. What stands out is the hand-off: from display boldness to Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs, a modern sans whose tall x-height rises near cap height.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Noto Sans Arabic keeps modern, wide openings on its small letters, and its pronounced x-height stands up tall. Wallpoet earns its keep when it is big, bold and brief.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-batak: Wallpoet comes in loud, with high lowercase and slivers of white. Noto Sans Batak, a sans with a towering x-height and a wide e, steps in beside it and makes the whole layout approachable.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuki: Slotted, loud and high-reaching, Wallpoet is built to grab attention the moment it appears. But Noto Sans Bhaiksuki, with plump lowercase and open apertures, is the one built to be read.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Contemporary is the feel of Noto Sans Brahmi, with a high mean line and open-ended curves on every rounded letter. Wallpoet supplies the shout, and that gap is the draw.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Noto Sans Buhid sets generous room between curve ends and stems. Below the bold, slotted Wallpoet, its high-set x-height makes running text feel modern, settled and easy on the eyes.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-carian: Clean is the word: Noto Sans Carian keeps its terminals apart. Wallpoet then does the shouting up top, and the two settle into a clear division of labor on the page.
